00046 NeuralNetworkSimpleInternal::NeuralNetworkSimpleInternal(IntArray const& numNodes, 
00047                              const float _learnRate, 
00048                              const float _actFuncOffset) throw()
00049 : learnRate(_learnRate),
00050   actFuncOffset(_actFuncOffset),
00051   layers((numNodes.size() < 2 ? 2 : numNodes.size())-1)
00052 {
00053   const int numLayers = numNodes.size();
00054   
00055   if(getNumLayersIncludingInput() == numLayers)
00056   {
00057     const int size = getNumLayersExcludingInput();
00058     for(int i = 0; i < size; i++)
00059     {
00060       int numLayerInputs = numNodes.atUnchecked(i);
00061       int numLayerOutputs = numNodes.atUnchecked(i+1);
00062       
00063       if(numLayerInputs < 1) numLayerInputs = 1;
00064       if(numLayerOutputs < 1) numLayerOutputs = 1;
00065       
00066       layers[i] = NeuralLayer(numLayerOutputs, numLayerInputs);
00067     }
00068     
00069     numInputs = numNodes.atUnchecked(0);
00070     numOutputs = numNodes.atUnchecked(numLayers-1);
00071   }
00072   else if(numLayers == 1)
00073   {
00074     int num = numNodes.atUnchecked(0);
00075     if(num < 1) num = 1;
00076     
00077     layers[0] = NeuralLayer(num, num);
00078     layers[1] = NeuralLayer(num, num);
00079 
00080     numInputs = num;
00081     numOutputs = num;
00082   }
00083   else
00084   {
00085     layers[0] = NeuralLayer(1, 1);
00086     layers[1] = NeuralLayer(1, 1);
00087     
00088     numInputs = 1;
00089     numOutputs = 1;
00090   }
00091   
00092   errorVector = NumericalArray<float>::withSize(numOutputs);
00093 }

00157 void NeuralNetworkSimpleInternal::write(TextFileWriter const& _file) const throw()
00158 {
00159   const int intFieldWidth = 4;
00160   const int size = 128;
00161   char buf[size];
00162   
00163   TextFileWriter file = _file;
00164   
00165   file.write("NeuralNetworkSimple:v1\n");
00166   
00167   snprintf(buf, size, "learnRate: %f actFuncOffset: %f\n", getLearnRate(), getActFuncOffset());
00168   file.write(buf);
00169   
00170   snprintf(buf, size, "Layers:%*d\n", intFieldWidth, getNumLayersIncludingInput());
00171   file.write(buf);
00172   
00173   snprintf(buf, size, "Layer %*d:%*d\n", intFieldWidth, 0, 
00174                        intFieldWidth, numInputs);
00175   file.write(buf);
00176   
00177   for(int layer = 0; layer < getNumLayersExcludingInput(); layer++)
00178   {
00179     snprintf(buf, size, "Layer %*d:%*d\n", intFieldWidth, layer+1, 
00180                          intFieldWidth, getNumNodesOnLayer(layer));
00181     file.write(buf);
00182   }
00183     
00184   for(int layer = 0; layer < getNumLayersExcludingInput(); layer++)
00185   {
00186     const int numNodes = getNumNodesOnLayer(layer);
00187     for(int node = 0; node < numNodes; node++)
00188     {
00189       NumericalArray<float> weights;
00190       float threshold;
00191       get(layer, node, &weights, threshold);
00192         
00193       snprintf(buf, size, "%*d %*d %*d   %.16f\n", intFieldWidth, layer, 
00194                              intFieldWidth, node, 
00195                              intFieldWidth, -1, 
00196                              threshold);
00197       file.write(buf);
00198       
00199       const int numWeights = weights.size();
00200       for(int weight = 0; weight < numWeights; weight++)
00201       {
00202         snprintf(buf, size, "%*d %*d %*d   %.16f\n", intFieldWidth, layer, 
00203                                intFieldWidth, node, 
00204                                intFieldWidth, weight, 
00205                                weights[weight]);
00206         file.write(buf);
00207       }
00208     }
00209   }
00210   
00211 }

00213 NumericalArray<float> NeuralNetworkSimpleInternal::propogate(NumericalArray<float> const& inputVector) throw()
00214 {
00215   NumericalArray<float> vector = inputVector;
00216   
00217   NeuralLayer *layersPtr = layers.getArray();
00218   const int size = getNumLayersExcludingInput();
00219   for(int i = 0; i < size; i++)
00220   {
00221     vector = layersPtr[i].propogate(vector);
00222   } 
00223   
00224   return vector;

00227 void NeuralNetworkSimpleInternal::backProp(NumericalArray<float> const& inputVector, NumericalArray<float> const& targetVector) throw()
00228 {
00229   NumericalArray<float> outputVector = propogate(inputVector);  
00230 
00231   float* errorVectorPtr = errorVector.getArray();
00232   const float* targetVectorPtr = targetVector.getArray();
00233   const float* outputVectorPtr = outputVector.getArray();
00234   
00235   const int size = errorVector.size();
00236   for(int i = 0; i < size; i++)
00237   {
00238     errorVectorPtr[i] = targetVectorPtr[i] - outputVectorPtr[i];
00239   }
00240   
00241   NumericalArray<float> vector = errorVector;
00242   
00243   NeuralLayer *layersPtr = layers.getArray();
00244   for(int i = getNumLayersExcludingInput()-1; i >= 0; i--)
00245   {
00246     vector = layersPtr[i].backProp(vector, actFuncOffset, learnRate);
00247   }
00248 }

00250 void NeuralNetworkSimpleInternal::train(NeuralPatternArray const& patterns, const int count) throw()
00251 {
00252   const NeuralPattern *patternPtr = patterns.getArray();
00253   
00254   if(patternPtr != 0)
00255   {
00256     for(int iteration = 0; iteration < count; iteration++)
00257     {
00258       const int numPatterns = patterns.size();
00259       for(int patternIndex = 0; patternIndex < numPatterns; patternIndex++)
00260       {
00261         const NeuralPattern& pattern = patternPtr[patternIndex];
00262         
00263         if(pattern.getInternal() != 0)
00264           backProp(pattern.getInputVector(), pattern.getOutputVector());
00265       }
00266     }
00267   }
00268 }

00270 void NeuralNetwork::read(TextFileReader const& _file) throw()
00271 {
00272   TextFileReader file = _file;
00273   
00274   Text text;
00275   int line = 0;
00276   int numLayers = -1;
00277   float learnRate, actFuncOffset;
00278   
00279   IntArray nodes;
00280   
00281   while(file.isEof() == false)
00282   {
00283     text = file.readLine();
00284     
00285     if(line == 0)
00286     {
00287       // should be the format/version string
00288       if(text.contains("NeuralNetworkSimple:v1") == false)
00289       {
00290         printf("NeuralNetwork::read wrong version type\n");
00291         return;
00292       }
00293     }
00294     else if(line == 1)
00295     {
00296       // should be learn rate and act func offset     
00297       sscanf(text.getArray(), "learnRate: %f actFuncOffset: %f", &learnRate, &actFuncOffset);
00298     }
00299     else if(line == 2)
00300     {
00301       // should be the number of layers     
00302       sscanf(text.getArray(), "Layers:%d", &numLayers);
00303       
00304       if(numLayers < 2) 
00305       {
00306         printf("NeuralNetwork::read invalid number of layers\n");
00307         return;
00308       }
00309       
00310       nodes = IntArray::withSize(numLayers, false);
00311     }
00312     else if(numLayers > 0)
00313     {
00314       int layer, numNodes;
00315       sscanf(text.getArray(), "Layer %d:%d", &layer, &numNodes);
00316       numLayers--;
00317       
00318       nodes[layer] = numNodes;
00319       
00320       if(numLayers == 0)
00321       {       
00322         if(nodes == getStructure())
00323         {
00324           setLearnRate(learnRate);
00325           setActFuncOffset(actFuncOffset);
00326         }
00327         else
00328         {
00329           setInternal(new NeuralNetworkSimpleInternal(nodes, learnRate, actFuncOffset));
00330         }
00331       }
00332     }
00333     else
00334     {
00335       // it's a weight or a threshold
00336       int layer, node, index;
00337       float value;
00338       sscanf(text.getArray(), "%d %d %d %f", &layer, &node, &index, &value);
00339       
00340       if(index < 0)
00341         setThreshold(layer, node, value);
00342       else
00343         setWeight(layer, node, index, value);
00344     }
00345     
00346     line++;
00347   }   
00348 }
